comment: An M1A2 Abrams tank (62 t) on firm ground: seven road wheels a side on torsion bar road arms, dampers at stations 1, 2 and 7, a rear drive sprocket, a front idler, two return rollers and a single pin track a side (78 left and 78 right links, 156 in all), the sprockets on PID speed controllers. It settles for 1 s, drives away to 1.5 m/s and turns right. Contact on the exact surfaces of the STEP parts. The masses, springs, dampers and the track are estimates; see readme.rst. x forward, y right, z down. Written by examples/m1a2/generate_m1a2.py.
